mapper.select:
SELECT p.SOU_NO, p.EXT_PROJECT_NO, p.SOU_NAME, p.PROJECT_ID, p.EXT_SCALE_QUANTITY, p.EXT_BUDGET, p.EXT_CATEGORY_ID, p.EXT_CATEGORY_CODE, p.EXT_CATEGORY_NAME, p.CREATION_DATE, p.EXT_ORG_BU_ID, p.EXT_ORG_BU_CODE, p.EXT_ORG_BU_NAME, p.EXT_ORG_OU_ID, p.EXT_ORG_OU_CODE, p.EXT_ORG_OU_NAME, v.VENDOR_ID, v.VENDOR_CODE, v.VENDOR_NAME, v.EXT_VENDOR_ATTR, v.LINKMAN_NAME, v.PHONE, v.EXT_IS_NEW_VENDOR, o.ORDER_ID, p.EXT_TECH_PRINCIPAL, p.EXT_TECH_PRINCIPAL_TEL, p.CREATED_FULL_NAME, p.EXT_SOU_PROCESS, o.ORDER_STATUS, p.PROJECT_STATUS FROM scc_sou_project p join scc_sou_vendor v on v.PROJECT_ID = p.PROJECT_ID join scc_sou_order o on o.PROJECT_ID = p.PROJECT_ID and o.VENDOR_ID = v.VENDOR_ID JOIN ext_scc_sou_order eo on eo.ORDER_ID = o.ORDER_ID and eo.ROUND = 1 and eo.ORDER_STATUS IN ('SUBMISSION', 'CANCEL')
join (select DISTINCT nd.PROJECT_ID from meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_supplier_cooperate.scc_pr_requirement_head h join meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_supplier_cooperate.scc_npm_pr_require_head eh on eh.REQUIREMENT_HEAD_ID = h.REQUIREMENT_HEAD_ID and eh.REQUIRE_FROM = #{requirementPlanType} join scc_npm_sou_demand nd on nd.APPLICANT_NO = h.REQUIREMENT_HEAD_NUM ) pt on pt.PROJECT_ID = p.PROJECT_ID
JOIN (select DISTINCT nd.PROJECT_ID from meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_supplier_cooperate.scc_pr_requirement_head h join meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_supplier_cooperate.scc_npm_pr_require_group rg on rg.REQUIREMENT_HEAD_ID = h.REQUIREMENT_HEAD_ID and rg.GROUP_TYPE='VENDOR' and rg.FULL_NAME like CONCAT('%',#{vendorPrincipal},'%') join scc_npm_sou_demand nd on nd.APPLICANT_NO = h.REQUIREMENT_HEAD_NUM) vt on vt.PROJECT_ID = p.PROJECT_ID
JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ca.project_id, cs.vendor_id from scc_npm_sou_ca ca join scc_npm_sou_ca_supplier cs on cs.ca_id = ca.ca_id and cs.tech_score >= #{techSocreFrom} and cs.tech_score <= #{techSocreTo} and cs.composite_score >= #{comprehensiveScoreFrom} and cs.composite_score <= #{comprehensiveScoreTo} where ca.type = 'APPLY' and ca.`status` = 'APPROVED') cs on cs.project_id = p.PROJECT_ID and cs.vendor_id = v.VENDOR_ID
JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ca.project_id, cs.vendor_id from scc_npm_sou_ca ca join scc_npm_sou_ca_selection_result cs on cs.ca_id = ca.ca_id and cs.is_win =#{isWin} where ca.type = 'APPLY' and ca.`status` = 'APPROVED') cr on cr.project_id = p.PROJECT_ID and cr.vendor_id = v.VENDOR_ID
where p.SOU_TYPE = 'bid' and p.EXT_PROJECT_NO like CONCAT('%',#{extProjectNo},'%')
and p.EXT_ORG_BU_CODE like CONCAT('%',#{extOrgBuCode},'%')
and p.EXT_ORG_BU_NAME like CONCAT('%',#{extOrgBuName},'%')
and p.EXT_ORG_OU_NAME like CONCAT('%',#{extOrgOuName},'%')
and substring(p.EXT_PROJECT_NO, 1, 2) like CONCAT(#{companyShortCode},'%')
and DATE_FORMAT(p.CREATION_DATE,'%Y') like CONCAT('%',#{year},'%')
and DATE_FORMAT(p.CREATION_DATE,'%m') like CONCAT('%',#{month},'%')
and p.SOU_NAME like CONCAT('%',#{souName},'%')
and p.EXT_SOU_PROCESS = #{extSouProcess}
and p.EXT_CATEGORY_NAME like CONCAT('%',#{itemDesc},'%')
and p.CREATED_FULL_NAME like CONCAT('%',#{souPrincipal},'%')
and p.EXT_TECH_PRINCIPAL like CONCAT('%',#{souPrincipal},'%')
and EXISTS ( select 1 from scc_sou_group le where le.PROJECT_ID = p.PROJECT_ID and le.GROUP_ROLE = 'LEADER' and le.FULL_NAME like CONCAT('%',#{leaderPrincipal},'%') limit 1 )
and p.EXT_BUDGET >= #{totalBudgetFrom}
and p.EXT_BUDGET <= #{totalBudgetTo}
and v.VENDOR_NAME like CONCAT('%',#{vendorName},'%')
and v.EXT_VENDOR_ATTR = #{extVendorAttr}
and v.LINKMAN_NAME like CONCAT('%',#{linkmanName},'%')
and v.PHONE like CONCAT('%',#{phone},'%')
and v.EXT_IS_NEW_VENDOR = #{extIsNewVendor}
GROUP BY o.ORDER_ID ORDER BY p.PROJECT_ID DESC
